summary: Circumstantial evidence murder conviction appeal; death due to head injuries on 2.2.1997; prosecution witnesses placed appellants with deceased; panchayat rivalry motive; threats established; co-accused testimony; High Court altered Section 302/34 IPC to Section 304 Part I IPC; reduced sentence from life imprisonment to 7 years RI; standard of proof in circumstantial cases; benefit of doubt to accused.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under Section 304 Part I IPC confirmed; sentence enhanced from 7 years RI to 10 years RI.
